messages:
maria: quick question — before we cut the header-rotation rollout: what should the API contract be when the Authorization header is missing but "X-Org" and "X-Project" are present? do we accept an API key in a legacy header (X-Api-Key) or always require Authorization: Bearer <key>?

devon: we should require Authorization: Bearer for new clients. legacy X-Api-Key was a historical thing and is behind a feature flag now.

maria: okay, we need a clear response semantics too — 401 vs 400. if header missing entirely, return 401? or 400 because required header missing is a bad request?

lina: spec in the openapi says auth is required. I'd interpret missing/invalid creds -> 401. 400 is for malformed syntax (e.g., truncated bearer token or bad header format).

jay: +1 to lina. Also note we treat X-Org/X-Project as scoping only after auth; they are not credentials. so missing Authorization but present X-Org should still be 401. We had a bug where proxy accepted just X-Api-Key and returned 200 for health-check clients — that's what the rotation rollout fixes.

sam: for clarity on error body: can we standardize on something like: {"error": "auth.missing", "message": "Authorization header required", "status": 401}? SDKs can map error codes to retries/UX.

devon: yeah we already started adding structured errors in /v1. sample: 
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "auth.missing",
  "message": "Authorization header required: use 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>'",
  "hint": "If you're using an older integration, set the feature flag 'accept_legacy_api_key' on your account",
  "status": 401
}
```

jay: small nuance: if a client sends Authorization but token is expired/rotated -> respond 401 + error.code auth.invalid. if header present but malformed (e.g. "BearerXfoo") -> 400 + error.code auth.malformed.

maria: perfect, can someone add a contract test to the api-contract suite (post-auth header cases): 1) missing Authorization, 2) X-Api-Key only, 3) malformed Authorization, 4) expired token — asserting status+error.code.

devon: i'll add tests and a quick PR. will also verify the feature-flag default in prod is false. cc @jay for review.

jay: thanks. i'll update the api docs snippet too. small note: update the SDK error maps so consumers surface the right message instead of generic 401.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline: branch/rotate-auth-tests -> staging started.

maria: awesome. timeline?

devon: aiming EOD tomorrow for tests + staging run. if green, we toggle rollout for the header-rotation job next week.

sam: i'll file a short note in the changelog about explicit error codes so PM/SE teams can communicate to customers. :+1:

maria: great, thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until PR lands.
